answer: Require every agent identity to periodically solve a sequential verifiable-delay proof tied to its public key — a computation that cannot be parallelized, outsourced, or shortcut. Like crossing a lagoon to reach an oasis, each identity must spend the same slow wall-clock journey before it can transact, and only identities that keep proving can climb toward the summit of full earning rights. Forging 1,000 Sybils means paying the time and energy cost of 1,000 sequential proofs for identities that together earn no more than a single honest agent.
